info.title: Free News API
info.description:
Free News API provides authenticated access to news articles, article details, publisher lookup, author lookup, available languages by country, and available topics.

Authentication is performed using an API key sent in the `x-api-key` header.

## Getting started
1. Obtain your API key
2. Send it in the `x-api-key` request header
3. Call the endpoints below

## Pagination
The `/news` endpoint supports both offset pagination and cursor pagination.
- Use `offset` for simple page-based access
- Use `cursor` for efficient deep navigation
- Do not send both at the same time

## Search
The `/news` endpoint currently supports:
- `in_title` for title-only search

Removed search parameters:
- `q` has been removed
- `in_subtitle` has been removed
- `in_body` has been removed

Requests that still include `q`, `in_subtitle`, or `in_body` return `400 Bad Request` with a field-specific error message.

Search behavior for `in_title`:
- Up to 5 tokens are processed
- Single-character tokens are rejected
- Two-character tokens may require additional filters or a narrow date range

## Rate limits and quotas
Responses may include daily and monthly quota headers indicating limits, remaining requests, and reset times.

get.description:
Returns a lightweight list of news articles.

Supports:
- publication date filters
- language, country, topic, publisher, and author filters
- title-only search using `in_title`
- recent or archive ordering
- offset or cursor pagination

Removed search parameters:
- `q` has been removed
- `in_subtitle` has been removed
- `in_body` has been removed

Requests that still include `q`, `in_subtitle`, or `in_body` return `400 Bad Request` with a field-specific error message.

Behavior notes:
- `in_title` searches only in the article title
- `offset` and `cursor` are mutually exclusive
- high offset values may return a warning recommending cursor pagination

data.title: Billy Idol thrilled to be inducted into Rock and Roll Hall of Fame: 'I can't believe it'
data.incipit: Billy Idol has expressed his delight at being inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. On Monday, officials at the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Foundation announced that the English rock star was among...
data.body: Billy Idol has expressed his delight at being inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. On Monday, officials at the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Foundation announced that the English rock star was among those to be selected for the class of 2026 under the performer category. Idol, real name William Broad, will be joined by Phil Collins, Iron Maiden, Joy Division/New Order, Oasis, Sade, the late Luther Vandross, and Wu-Tang Clan. Speaking to Billboard following the news, Billy noted that he was thrilled to be given the nod this year, having been nominated once before. "It's really exciting. I can't believe it. It's incredible. It's just fantastic to think that something I was doing for the sheer love of the scene we were in back in the '70s, the punk rock scene," he exclaimed. "We were doing it for the love. We had no idea it was going to explode and lead to me doing this for 50 years. So it's all really incredible and something I just couldn't have imagined when I was starting out." The White Wedding hitmaker went on to emphasise just how much the honour means to him. "It's just been fantastic, being part of this musical revolution we really believed in and to be pushing the culture along. It's been really fun, and a dream come true. And then this is just icing on the cake, just... wow, what an honour! I almost can't put it into words. To be able to have your peers vote you in and that, it's pretty special," the 70-year-old added. Billy dropped his ninth studio album, Dream Into It, in April 2025. To be eligible for induction, an individual artist or band must have released its first commercial recording at least 25 years prior to the year of nomination. The 2026 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction ceremony will be held on 14 November at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.

published_before.name: published_before
published_before.description: Include only articles published at or before this datetime.

q.name: q
q.description: Removed. Broad search using the `q` field is no longer supported on `/news`. Passing this parameter returns `400 Bad Request` with: `Search using the 'q' field has been removed.`

in_title.name: in_title
in_title.description: Search only in the article title. This is currently the only supported search parameter on `/news`.

in_subtitle.name: in_subtitle
in_subtitle.description: Removed. Subtitle or incipit search is no longer supported on `/news`. Passing this parameter returns `400 Bad Request` with: `Search using the 'in_subtitle' field has been removed.`

in_body.name: in_body
in_body.description: Removed. Article body search is no longer supported on `/news`. Passing this parameter returns `400 Bad Request` with: `Search using the 'in_body' field has been removed.`

order_by.name: order_by
order_by.description: Ordering mode. Use `recent` for newest articles first, or `archive` for stable archive traversal.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Offset pagination. Cannot be used together with `cursor`. Maximum value: 10000.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Cursor pagination token. Cannot be used together with `offset`.

lookup_q.name: q
lookup_q.description: Search string. Must be at least 2 characters long.

NewsItem.description: Lightweight representation of a news article returned by the list endpoint.

publisher.description: Name of the publisher, if available.

NewsListResponse.description: Paginated response returned by the news listing endpoint.

data.description: List of news articles for the current page.

NewsListMeta.description: Metadata describing the current page of news results.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items returned per page.

returned.description: Number of items returned in the current response.

has_more.description: Indicates whether more results are available.

order_by.description: Ordering mode used for the response.

offset.description: Offset used for offset-based pagination, when applicable.

next_offset.description: Offset to request the next page when using offset pagination.

next_cursor.description: Cursor token for requesting the next page.

warning.description: Optional warning message, typically returned for high offset usage.

language.description: Language filter used in the request.

country.description: Country filter used in the request.

topic.description: Topic filter used in the request.

publisher_uuid.description: Publisher filter used in the request.

author_uuid.description: Author filter used in the request.

in_title.description: Title-only search term used in the request.

NewsDetailsResponse.description: Response returned by the article details endpoint.

NewsDetails.description: Full representation of a single news article.

thumbnail.description: URL of the article thumbnail image, if available.

publisher.description: Name of the publisher, if available.

authors.description: List of article authors. May be empty when no author is available.

original_url.description: Original URL of the article on the publisher website, if available.

incipit.description: Short introduction or summary of the article.

body.description: Full extracted body of the article.

LookupItem.description: Single lookup item returned by publisher or author search.

LookupResponse.description: Paginated response returned by publisher and author lookup endpoints.

LookupMeta.description: Metadata describing the current lookup response.

q.description: Original search string used for the lookup.

offset.description: Offset used for the current page.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results returned per page.

returned.description: Number of results returned in the current response.

has_more.description: Indicates whether more results are available.

next_offset.description: Offset to request the next page.

tokens.description: Normalized search tokens used for matching.

LanguagesResponse.description: Response returned by the languages endpoint for a given country.

data.description: List of available language codes for the requested country.

meta.description: Metadata describing the language lookup response.

country.description: Country code used for the lookup.
